task: Add pagination integration tests for analytics drill-down modals and admin management tables (EPMCDME-13482).

component_scope.label: L
component_scope.affected: UserEngagementDrillDownModal, AssetReusabilityDrillDownModal, Admin Users table, Admin Cost Centers table, Admin Categories table, Admin MCPs table, Admin Budgets table, Admin Projects table, Admin Activity Events table

technical_risk.label: S
technical_risk.risk_factors: Reused the existing test-utils integration harness (renderPage, mockAPI, requestRegistry); had to accommodate per-table pagination variance (offset-based Activity Events vs page-based tables) and permission-gated setup/teardown (admin vs maintainer user, feature-flag mocking for MCPs, env-var toggling for Projects); a documented circular-import trap (importing @/store/analytics before @/test-utils/integration crashes SessionExpiredPopup) had to be avoided in each new file
technical_risk.mitigation: Followed established integration test patterns already used elsewhere in the suite; parametrized the seven admin tables via describe.each to isolate per-table configuration and keep risk contained to test code only, no production code touched

key_reasoning.reason: 45 tests span 9 distinct components across two feature domains (analytics drill-down modals, admin settings tables) — bumped from M to L for breadth even though each is additive test-only work
Integration tests exercise the full UI + store + mocked-API path per component, across two page domains, though no production layer code changed

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from M to L: affects multiple admin management tables (7 tables) and multiple analytics drill-down workflows in the same change
